name: asr-transcribe-to-text
description: >- Transcribes audio or video to speaker-labeled, timestamped text, locally with MLX on Apple Silicon or remotely. Use for 转录 / 录音转文字 / 说话人分离 / 字幕, and also for preparing audio for ASR without transcribing: 转格式, 降采样到 16kHz, merging recorder segments, or compressing and speeding up audio before 飞书妙记 — even when it looks like a one-line ffmpeg job.
author: daymade
